title: Expert-Persona Honesty Suppression: Do Role Prompts Make Models Fabricate Credentials?

original_idea.body: Expert-Persona Honesty Suppression. Problem: the dose-response of how expert personas suppress honest self-representation is open. Direction: build persona system prompts varying authority and domain, ask self-transparency probe questions, measure disclosure vs fabrication across personas on open models, identify which persona features most override honesty.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Strong chain: persona-driven honesty suppression yields unflagged unqualified advice, a concrete deployment harm.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Persona battery + self-transparency probes; prompting only.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused dose-response; some overlap with gen-3458 but well-defined.

novelty.reasoning: A recent paper already audits this; this extends to dose-response, largely incremental.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: The credential-fabrication persona effect is published; a dose-response extension is incremental.
